tuple_rule: For each public source, random.Random(domain|tuples|fixture_uid|seed).sample 64 distinct indices from lex C(8,3) x {0,1,2,3}^3; same RNG carried across permuted sources.
exceptions: Failed/nonzero source lift, x=0 interpolation, repeated x, cubic coefficient +/-1, nonsplit/repeated residual or residual outside exact FB are declared failures; no repair.
anchors: Only factor-base points matched to the already declared public source grid, with explicit checked scalar derivations. U=0 cells cannot count as unknown-log success.
stopping: All 4096 attempts per cell, independent of hits or rank; no extend-until-rank.
cost_units: Field calls, elliptic additions, modular-pow calls, source/aux cache hits and misses, candidate hashes and modular matrix element updates are separate raw units. Python overhead, pow internals and independent checks are not claimed as complete S.
